results.title: From fundamentals in calibration to modern methodologies
results.content: # From fundamentals in calibration to modern methodologies: A tutorial for small molecules quantification in liquid chromatography–mass spectrometry bioanalysis. When quantitative analysis is developed, an analyst usually refers to international guidelines for analytical method validation. This tutorial aims to synthetize the advances in LC‒MS quantitative analysis for small molecules in complex matrices, going from fundamental aspects in calibration to modern methodologies and applications. Finally, this tutorial outlines the importance of having international guidelines for analytical method validation that agree with the advances in calibration strategies and analytical instrumentation. He is focusing on metabolomics with special interest in method development, handling of biological samples and sample preparation approaches with an emphasis on metabolite quantification strategies for targeted and multitargeted metabolomic analyses. The group of Serge Rudaz is developing new strategies for targeted and untargeted metabolomics analyses and specializes in the analysis of low molecular weight compounds in biological matrices through collaborative projects in the fields of toxicology, biology, biochemistry, and pharmacology.
